title: Faith
introduction: Faith is humanity's response to God's revelation - trusting in his promises and surrendering to him. Throughout the Bible, we see that faith is the key to fellowship with God. Without faith it is impossible to please him.

sections.title: What Is Faith?
sections.description: Faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what we do not see.

sections.title: Examples of Faith
sections.description: The Bible is full of people who lived by faith and experienced God's power.

sections.title: Salvation by Faith
sections.description: Faith in Jesus Christ is the way to salvation and justification.

sections.title: The Power of Faith
sections.description: Jesus promised that even a little faith can accomplish great things.

sections.title: Faith and Works
sections.description: True faith shows itself in action - faith without works is dead.
